'''"One Shot" Wrenas''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At one point he resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] and passed his knowledge to the [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] who had won the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]].
